Evolution is a GNOME application that provides integrated email, calendar, contact management, and communications functionality.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* WebKitGTK 2.46.1: Middle mouse button inserts primary clipboard twice [rhel-7.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-62686)

* Backport evolution changes from RHEL 8 to RHEL 7 (JIRA:RHEL-62699)
